scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the cup-preparation run already started for the waste-free snack demonstration.
Emerging Need: Pre-rinsing and loading are underway, but a replacement washer will not accept the tall carrier holding the thirty cups.
Decision Context: The stored rack inventory supplies compatible shallow-rack capacity and an authorized local reracking procedure; neither forcing the carrier nor requesting an already committed backup kit solves this run.
Consequence: Reracking into existing compatible racks in time for the full machine cycle keeps the same thirty cups usable; once the demonstration service ends, that preparation can no longer serve it.

parameter.title: Waste-free snack demo cup station
parameter.description: Reuse Center community-room snack demo using washable cup set and neutral waste-reduction handout cards.

parameter.content: The RDK-A1 preparation is underway: all thirty cups are pre-rinsed and I am loading them in the tall carrier at the replacement washer. They have not completed a sanitation cycle yet.

parameter.subject: RDK-A1 loading halted: carrier clearance
parameter.body: The replacement washer rejected the tall RDK-A1 carrier before starting: carrier height exceeds door clearance. Machine is safe in loading mode; forcing or modifying the carrier is prohibited. The cycle requires 40 minutes, and the washer is booked for maintenance from 10:00. It cannot shorten or pause a sanitation cycle.

parameter.subject: Warewash workbench access this morning
parameter.body: Nia remains at the warewash workbench and can use the clean racks logged in the alcove inventory. RDK-B2 is committed to a different event and cannot be released. Loading must finish by 09:20 for the full 40-minute cycle before maintenance; the community-room delivery remains available for a completed load.

parameter.content: The snack demo service ended at 15:30. RDK-A1 never completed a wash cycle after the loading stop, so the station ran as a dry display. Cup service for this session is over.
